comments.text:
I did 32 years there. No AC trucks, but I never did a full riding route, I mostly walked until the last 6 years. While the pay and benefits were cut somewhat in 2013, it is still a good job.
Those strong enough to stick it out will have a pension, SS, & 401k, healthcare. 
While you are working you eventually get 5 paid weeks of vacation, 12 days of sick leave, 11 paid federal holidays, a new thing called Wounded Warrior for veterans ( more sick leave) 1.5 pay after 8 hours, 2x after 10 regardless if you have 40 hours for the week. You get contractual raises every year and 2 COLA adjustments. My pay tripled during my career. 
When you start working at ANY USPS office you will be the the lowest paid employee with the lowest seniority date. You get the worst assignments and the most overtime. These new carriers think they are the only ones that ever had to start at the bottom. 
I actually enjoyed my job. It had It's moments for sure, but ehat job doesn't? They have union representation. Im So glad Im not there anymore for this. I knew I had to leave when I saw someone crying just because they were taken off a riding route that day and placed on a walking  route. 😂
Kevin B
